capital_risk.daily_breach_action: halt new entries and cancel pending; do not remove protective exits
capital_risk.daily_loss_basis: cashflow-adjusted net equity including unrealized PnL and fees vs accounting-day opening equity; missing != realized loss
capital_risk.leverage5: scenario arithmetic only; excluded from first search
capital_risk.sizing_formula: Q_notional = min(C*a*L, C*0.0075/(stop_fraction+stress_cost_fraction), free_margin*L, remaining_coin_cap*L, remaining_gross_exposure, remaining_portfolio_stop_risk/(stop_fraction+stress_cost_fraction)); final margin=Q/L; include entry/exit fee buffers separately

clock: UTC for signals/windows; Asia/Jerusalem midnight for canonical accounting day

costs.execution: actual LTP is not order-book/queue evidence; require causal raw-trade fill model, strict trade-through sensitivity, and market-exit gaps; declare proxy limitations
costs.funding: historical symbol-specific rate, funding timestamp and mark price for each held boundary; missing=DATA_INVALID, not zero

end_window: Cancel pending; report open positions at end mark with estimated exit fee in net equity. Do not count post-window fills/PnL as 7D. Closed PF reported separately from open equity contribution.

entry.long: reference LTP - 0.10*ATR15; round down to tick
entry.on_expiry: cancel unfilled quantity; release only on terminal cancellation confirmation; keep protection for actual fills
entry.short: reference LTP + 0.10*ATR15; round up to tick

features.ATR15: Wilder ATR(14) on completed 15-minute bars; seed mean first 14 TR
features.RVOL5: latest completed 5m turnover / mean preceding 20 nonoverlapping completed 5m turnover bars; exclude current
features.swing5: 2 completed bars left and 2 right; available only after second right bar close
features.turnover_acceleration: latest completed 5m turnover / immediately preceding completed 5m turnover; zero denominator=UNAVAILABLE

mode: BACKTEST isolated Research/arm portfolio; no live changes

screen_gates.PF_required_formula: 1 + 46.6666666667 / abs(sum of net losses), when all PnL closed; do not interpret infinite PF with no losses as proof
screen_gates.confidence: PASS is economic screening only; no claim of stable monthly return or independence
screen_gates.min_unique_fills_formula: ceil(46.6666666667/(mean_actual_notional*0.006666666666667)); this is an economic envelope, not statistical power
screen_gates.near_zero: full-profile net <=0 => reject this configuration on this window; positive but below economic threshold => no 30D unless frozen plausible scaling is validated in canonical replay
screen_gates.return_target_30d: 20% to 30% actual 30D net, not a 7D forecast
screen_gates.robustness: leave-best-event-out net > 0; stress net > 0; no absent funding, timeline violations, unfinished data censor, or unmodeled leverage liquidation; risk gates satisfied

stop_G0.reference: most recent confirmed 5m low for LONG/high for SHORT on protective side of entry
stop_G0.rule: widen too-close structural stop to both floors; reject if either ceiling exceeded; never clip a structural invalidation inward

stop_G1.rule: explicit competing stop thesis, not described as structural protection; clamp ATR distance to price-fraction range

take_profit.comparison: conditional net TP / actual entry notional >=0.003; planned target is NOT unconditional expectancy
take_profit.rounding: away from entry; recompute risk and cost checks after tick/quantity rounding

window_status: Not present as raw market inputs in supplied archive; ingestion and completeness checks required; if previously used for tuning choose new untouched windows before inspecting returns
